verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Synthesia publishes an llms.txt at docs.synthesia.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200, API-focused content), and its marketing site serves a second llms.txt at www.synthesia.io/llms.txt with structured capability descriptions, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these files, and evidence of the docs' depth beyond the header and summary entries (e.g., a full-content variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.synthesia.io/llms.txt # Synthesia Documentation
Generate professional and engaging synthetic videos at-scale with Synthesia's API.
Developers can use the Interactive Avatars API to connect a Synthesia avatar to their existing AI agent while retaining control of their LLM, knowledge base, voice, and workflows.
